params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of search results to include in a page. Minimum of 1 and maximum of 250.

params.name: detail
params.description:
The amount of detail included in each result item.
   "full" will include all descriptions and comments and more fields on
   related items such as pull requests, branches and tasks.
   "slim" omits larger fulltext fields such as descriptions and comments
   and only references related items by id.
   The default is "full".

params.name: next
params.description: The next page token.

params.name: entity_types
params.description: A collection of entity_types to search. Defaults to story and epic. Supports: epic, iteration, objective, story.

items.docs: Search lets you search Epics and Stories based on desired parameters. Since ordering of the results can change over time (due to search ranking decay, new Epics and Stories being created), the `next` value from the previous response can be used as the path and query string for the next page to ensure stable ordering.

params.name: title
params.description: Search text to match against document titles. Supports fuzzy matching. Required.

params.name: archived
params.description: When true, find archived documents. When false, find non-archived documents.

params.name: created_by_me
params.description: When true, find documents created by the current user. When false, find documents NOT created by current user.

params.name: followed_by_me
params.description: When true, find documents that the current user is following. When false, find documents NOT followed.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of search results to include in a page. Minimum of 1 and maximum of 250.

params.name: next
params.description: The next page token.
